title: When the Language Breaks
author: Ada Dunmore
blurb: Oscar Nystrom, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around before the last bus to the old neighborhood is rerouted forever.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
